summaryZh: UCSD Smarr lab 研究生命如何利用时间，以及生物节律与现代生活要求之间的关系。实验室希望通过认识生物时间为健康、教育和个人及社会选择提供信息。官方负责人介绍列出其生物系统时间序列分析研究；TemPredict项目另说明整合可穿戴设备数据与每日症状报告。
methods: 生物系统时间序列分析（官方档案所述负责人研究）
整合可穿戴设备数据与每日症状报告（负责人TemPredict项目）

evidence.quote: UCSD Smarr lab Prof. Benjamin Smarr & Lab Understand how life uses time. Use this knowledge to improve health, education, and the world.
Modern life often conflicts with natural time by imposing social demands that go against the rhythms of our bodies.
UCSD Smarr lab Prof. Benjamin Smarr & Lab Understand how life uses time. Use this knowledge to improve health, education, and the world.

Smarr’s research focuses on time series analysis in biological systems, with an emphasis on practical information extraction for translational applications. Currently his main project is TemPredict, which brings together wearable device data from 50K people with over 1 million daily symptom reports. This massive data object is being used to identify signs of COVID-19 onset, progression, and recovery.
evidence.provenanceNote: 官方档案明确负责人研究聚焦生物系统时间序列分析；另将TemPredict列为其主要项目并说明数据整合，两种范围分开，不声称TemPredict必定采用时间序列分析。 简介用Currently但无项目内容日期；不认定2026年仍开展或已证疾病预测效能。
